observations: Octagonal stair/elevator tower, pale solid diagonal faces, tall glazed strips, top ventilation louvres and a courtyard door.
Narrow links connect the tower to the two office wings; their separate survey footprints match the published plan.
geometry: BVV LoD2 footprints, facade planes and roofs retained; small links admitted explicitly rather than dropping the general 20-square-metre threshold.
inferences: Opening dimensions, louvre spacing, door placement within the southwest face and colour are estimated.
The west link is treated as single-level; the taller south junction repeats the adjacent two-level glazing arrangement.
Below-grade foundation geometry is retained. No interior spaces or precise current as-built facade schedule are claimed.
